name: Stone Age (Palaeolithic-Mesolithic)
description: Hunter-gatherer occupation from the Middle Palaeolithic (contested earliest dates) through the microlithic 'Balangoda culture', which persisted alongside Iron Age communities.

name: Protohistoric Early Iron Age
description: Iron, horses, cattle, rice cultivation and black-and-red ware appear; megalithic burials. Dated at Anuradhapura from c. 900 BCE.

name: Early Historic
description: Urbanisation, Brahmi writing, state formation and the establishment of Buddhism.

name: Middle Historic
description: Mature Anuradhapura and Polonnaruwa states, monumental hydraulic works, Indian Ocean trade.

name: Late Historic
description: Shift of political centres to the south-west and the hill country; the Jaffna kingdom in the north.

name: Early Modern / Colonial
description: European maritime empires; the Kandyan kingdom until 1815; British rule over the whole island 1815-1948.

name: Post-independence
description: Dominion of Ceylon (1948-72) and Republic of Sri Lanka (1972-).

name: Anuradhapura
description: Capital from Pandukabhaya (conventional 437 BCE; Geiger 377 BCE) until the Chola conquest of 1017.

name: Polonnaruwa
description: Sinhala royal capital from Vijayabahu I's restoration to the invasion of Kalinga Magha.

name: Dambadeniya
description: Capital under Vijayabahu III and Parakramabahu II.

name: Yapahuwa
description: Fortified capital of Bhuvanekabahu I.

name: Kurunegala
description: Capital of several fourteenth-century rulers.

name: Gampola
description: Hill-country capital; dominant ministers of the Alagakkonara family.

name: Kotte
description: Founded as capital by Parakramabahu VI; bequeathed to the Portuguese crown by Dharmapala (d. 1597).

name: Sitawaka
description: Kingdom of Mayadunne and Rajasinghe I, principal opponent of the Portuguese.

name: Kandy
description: Hill-country kingdom; independent until the Kandyan Convention of 1815. Start date approximate.

name: Jaffna
description: Kingdom of the Aryacakravarti dynasty in the north. Origins and start date debated (13th century).

name: Dominion of Ceylon
description: Independent dominion within the Commonwealth.

name: Republic of Sri Lanka
description: Republic from 22 May 1972. Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte became the legislative capital in 1982; Colombo remains the commercial capital.

name: Chola rule
description: Rajarata administered as a Chola province (Mummudi-cola-mandalam) from Polonnaruwa.

name: Kalinga Magha
description: Rule of the invader Magha at Polonnaruwa; end date approximate.

name: Portuguese
description: Portuguese presence and, from 1597, rule over much of the maritime lowlands.

name: Dutch (VOC)
description: Dutch East India Company rule over the maritime provinces.

name: British
description: East India Company (1796-1802) then Crown Colony; whole island from 1815.
